inputs.scenario: synthetic Code 119 Probe compiled from a Providence scenario seed to native Windows Realmz files
inputs.ally: opcode 89 adds a one-stamina monster whose death macro is an Extra Action Point containing only CODE 119
inputs.battle: opcode 2 starts a battle against four high-stamina hostile monsters with 1d2 attacks
inputs.input: SDL Right Arrow enters the Action Point; SDL g Guards every party activation

castleRuntimeObservation.deathMacro: killbody restores the subject's field cells to ground, clears its turn-queue entry, and runs CODE 119, which sets stamina one and friendly allegiance
castleRuntimeObservation.turnOrder: getbattleorder runs once in combatsetup; the cleared queue entry is never restored, so the revived ally is absent from every later round
castleRuntimeObservation.battlefield: the revived ally never returns to field occupancy
castleRuntimeObservation.afterRevival: in every run the ally stayed at one stamina, was never queued, never acted, and never reappeared on the map
castleRuntimeObservation.afterCombat: bodycount keeps living friendly allies, so the revived ally survives the battle

realmz2ChosenResult.pendingMacro: retain the defeated monster footprint until the death macro completes
realmz2ChosenResult.stillDead: remove the footprint before battle resolution continues
realmz2ChosenResult.revived: remove the footprint and record the monster as sidelined: alive, unpositioned, skipped for activations, not a target, and retained by post-battle ally selection
realmz2ChosenResult.saveBoundary: sidelinedMonsterIds is the only legal source of a living unpositioned monster; a sidelined monster may never hold a footprint
realmz2ChosenResult.correction: Castle's getrange still admits the off-field record by stamina and allegiance; Rebuilt does not target a sidelined monster
